---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Lars
To: Sam Xu; Carmen Iversen; Soren Underhill; Leon Yamamoto
Subject: Vendor Demonstration: Contract Lifecycle Management Platform (Evaluation Phase II)
When: Tuesday, 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Where: Conference Room 4B / Teams

Colleagues,

Pursuant to the Procurement Committee's directive of last quarter, Rasmussen Achterberg Law Group will be hosting the second-phase demonstration of the proposed contract lifecycle management platform. Attendance by all listed parties is requested to satisfy the evaluation documentation requirements.

Proposed agenda:
1. Introductions and vendor company overview (approx. 15 min)
2. Review of vendor's client portfolio and case studies (approx. 15 min)
3. Live demonstration of clause library and redlining functionality, using a sanitized excerpt from the Hakimi contract (approx. 15 min)
4. Security, data retention, and privilege safeguards (approx. 5 min)
5. Questions (time permitting)

Please note that items 1 and 2 substantially duplicate the materials circulated with the Phase I packet, which all attendees are expected to have reviewed in advance. The Committee nonetheless requests that the full agenda be observed for consistency with the Phase I session.

Evaluation scoring forms will be distributed following the session and are due within five (5) business days. Late submissions will not be incorporated into the Committee's final recommendation memorandum. 📋

Kindly confirm attendance by close of business Friday.

Regards,
Lars
